name: @pipeworx/mcp-mississippi-code

tools.name: ms_code_section
tools.description: Get the text of a section of the Mississippi Code of 1972 (Annotated) — Mississippi state law — by citation. "97-3-19" is homicide/murder; "89-8-19" is a landlord's duty to return a security deposit. Accepts natural forms: "97-3-19", "Miss. Code Ann. § 97-3-19", "Section 97-3-19", "§ 97-3-19". Returns the catchline, the operative statutory text, the legislative "HISTORY:" line, and amendment/cross-reference notes when present — case-law annotations are deliberately excluded (can run to hundreds of entries per section). IMPORTANT: this source is a static public-domain copy current only through Release 78 (2020-07-08) — it will NOT reflect any amendment enacted 2021 or later; check `current_through` on every response. Also returns later_acts: a dated, linked overlay of every act this pack found in Mississippi's own signed-bill text touching this exact citation since the 2020-07-08 snapshot (chapter number, session, bill link) — NOT merged into the text, explicitly labelled so, with sessions_checked naming every session the overlay covers even when later_acts is empty. Use for "what does MS 97-3-19 say" or to check a Mississippi statute AND whether it has been amended since 2020-07-08. Keyless.

citation.description: Section citation, e.g. "97-3-19" (homicide) or "89-8-19" (security deposits). Title-chapter-section, dot/hyphen separated.

tools.name: ms_code_chapters
tools.description: List the chapters within a title of the Mississippi Code of 1972, by title number ("97" is Crimes, "89" is Real and Personal Property, "27" is Taxation and Finance). Use this to browse a title when you do not have an exact section citation. Returns every chapter heading and number; call ms_code_section once you have a citation, or ms_code_search to find one by topic. Keyless.

title.description: Title number, e.g. 97 (Crimes) or 89 (Real and Personal Property). Mississippi titles are odd numbers 1-99.

tools.name: ms_code_search
tools.description: Search the Mississippi Code of 1972 BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "security deposit", "concealed carry", "DUI per se limit", "homicide". Matches against every section's official CATCHLINE across the whole Code (not full statutory body text — there is no full-text search anywhere in this source chain; the official LexisNexis tool, Justia, and FindLaw all sit behind the same Cloudflare bot-check, confirmed live). Returns matching citations, titles, and catchlines; call ms_code_section with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "security deposit return".

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mississippi-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mississippi-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
